text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Blessed with both talent and the perfect 
racing environment... I'm no match for 
Umamusume from such a 'different world.' 
So there's no point in fighting, no point 
in running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll shatter the preconceived notions 
ingrained back home. That's why Katsuragi 
Ace runs. To prove that no "different 
world" truly exists.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Standing in her path was her classmate, 
Mr. C.B.—a prodigy whose talent was the 
talk of the town even before her debut.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace was fired up. To prove that 
common sense can be shattered, she must 
overcome a towering wall.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal: to become an "Ace" in the world 
of Umamusume. As a pioneer for the 
"have-nots," Katsuragi Ace begins her 
charge!
